description:
🎯 Sniper Dan is Clumsy County’s long-range problem solver!

Take on hundreds of hilarious jobs across six lively locations in this family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist.

Read your Job Notes, decipher the clues, scan busy 3D scenes through your sniper scope and take the perfect shot to make things right. No violence. Just wholesome chaos and good intentions.

Beyond the day job, discover Time Attack, Ammo Hunt, Mini-Games, Carnival Games, Photo Mode, secret activities, rifle upgrades and plenty of ways to customise Dan and his office.

🔥 Want to go Hotshot? Sniper Dan: Hotshot Edition includes the full game plus the Hotshot DLC, featuring 18 gamer-themed cosmetic items to transform Dan, his rifle and office.

Already picking up the base game? The Hotshot DLC will also be available separately on PlayStation Store.

🔍 Spot the problem.
🎯 Take the shot.
🛠️ Make things right.

Sniper Dan is out now on PlayStation®5 !
